newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 10.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- President Jacques Chirac uses opportunity created by international human right day to call for respect of republican principles, warns against racism and discrimination.
-- Break of shareholders' pact at Club Mediterranee fuels rumours of possible buyout offer, boost shares.

-- Foreign investment-banking firms in France in 1996 benefited from trend toward of mergers, acquisitions and unwinding of cross-shareholding agreements, while privatisations did not prove profitable.
-- Local authorities "collectivites territoriales" raised local taxes by 7 percent in 1996, according to official figures to be published today. A stagnation is expected for 1997.
